test_decisions.scenario: Authentic GitHub Checks API can return a completed/failure check during session-review startup. Continue only for exact-target non-authorizing statuses, rejecting completed/success, neutral, skipped, premature conclusion, malformed state or identity drift.
test_decisions.requirement: R127-06 and R127-07: session-review exact SHA state transition must remain fail-closed while processing a real operator review or its absence.

search.scope: Existing GitHub check writer and workflow test module; extend the current tests rather than creating duplicate runners.

candidates.oracle: Completed failure cannot authorize; a new write may remain blocking while review and technical evidence are still being inspected.
candidates.comparison: Reuse the existing workflow-runner test and add safe/fail-unsafe enumerated status outcomes to the same module.

candidates.oracle: Existing unit contract proves failure publication and journal state but not alternate GitHub POST statuses.
candidates.comparison: Preserve original journal regressions, extend the workflow suite only for the state-transport boundary.

test_decisions.justification: Existing test discovery, workflow API mocks and identity checks are retained; the new discriminator comes from a failure observed in real GitHub-hosted Actions for PR #134.
